external_validation_result.source: v11.2 release and CI replay after GitHub read integration
external_validation_result.summary: The v11.2 GitHub provider read chain is reproducible as read-only evidence, but it remains supporting evidence only and must not be treated as semantic truth or write safety.

confidence_before.basis: provider-read-integration-audit passed and v11.2 release CI succeeded, but the external validation result had not yet been replayed into a confidence decision.

confidence_after.basis: The external validation result supports the read-only evidence chain while keeping freshness, semantic truth, write safety, and adoption limits explicit.

confidence_delta.rationale: Replay increases confidence that the provider-read chain is inspectable and bounded, without upgrading it to semantic truth or production safety.

replay_steps.observation: Provider, repository, adapter, resource, observed objects, decision, no-write boundary, and not-proven boundary are present.
replay_steps.confidence_effect: Supports the structural and runtime confidence of the v11.2 provider read chain.

replay_steps.observation: Audit verifies read-only command classification, observed provider outputs, resolvable evidence refs, and no external writes.
replay_steps.confidence_effect: Supports confidence that the chain is governed and not merely an ad hoc observation.

replay_steps.observation: Release evidence documents the provider-read capability and its explicit not-proven boundaries.
replay_steps.confidence_effect: Prevents the validation result from being overclaimed as provider truth, write safety, or adoption proof.

governance_route.reason: The result is partial but non-conflicting; it strengthens the provider-read confidence chain while preserving all not-proven boundaries.
governance_route.next_action: Release v11.3 as a replay audit that accepts external validation results only as bounded supporting evidence unless stronger independent validation exists.

selected_decision.rationale: The external validation replay is coherent, references the v11.2 provider read chain, updates confidence explicitly, and does not authorize writes.
selected_decision.next_action: Run external-validation-replay-audit and include it in release-state-audit for v11.3.

not_proven: This replay does not prove provider semantic truth, credential safety, GitHub write safety, production automation safety, market value, broad adoption, or independent third-party validation.
notes: v11.3 accepts external validation results as confidence-changing evidence only; conflicting or weak results must route to governance.
